verdict.rationale: Attio documents an official MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT or other AI tools search and manage workspace data, alongside a public REST API with filtering, a Deal object and interaction history. Its own AI is marketed as able to 'create account briefs'. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that recent emails and interaction history are exposed through the API/MCP tools, documentation of MCP tool coverage for deals and timeline data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-built briefs.
